title: OPS-02 Minimum Dataset Sufficiency and Readiness Gate Matrix
purpose: Define objective, multi-dimensional gating criteria that must be satisfied before OPS-02 can be declared ready for model training. Reaching minimum targets is a gating condition, not proof of scientific sufficiency.

readiness_matrix.scientific_rationale: OPS-01 contained only 27 parents (12 TRAIN / 7 DEV / 8 HOLDOUT). A minimum of 60 scenes is required to allocate >= 35 TRAIN, >= 12 DEV, and >= 13 HOLDOUT, providing enough degrees of freedom to measure scene-level generalization without high variance.

readiness_matrix.minimum_target: >= 8 independent parents per class (>= 4 TRAIN, >= 2 DEV, >= 2 HOLDOUT)
readiness_matrix.hard_failure_threshold: < 4 independent parents for any priority class, or 0 parents in DEV/HOLDOUT
readiness_matrix.scientific_rationale: In EXP-07, AF, OF, RF, IWs, and HM had 0 DEV pixels and <= 4 TRAIN parents, causing an irrecoverable zero-IoU evaluation defect. Every evaluated class must have multiple independent test scenes.

readiness_matrix.minimum_target: 100% of the 12 canonical classes present with >= 1,000 GT pixels in DEV and >= 1,000 in HOLDOUT
readiness_matrix.preferred_target: >= 10,000 GT pixels per class in both DEV and HOLDOUT
readiness_matrix.hard_failure_threshold: Any canonical class having 0 GT pixels in DEV or HOLDOUT
readiness_matrix.scientific_rationale: Evaluating IoU on an empty class yields a degenerate metric (0/0), distorting macro-mIoU and masking model capabilities.

readiness_matrix.minimum_target: >= 4 distinct major ocean basins / regional seas; no single region > 50% of samples
readiness_matrix.preferred_target: >= 8 distinct regional sea regimes globally distributed
readiness_matrix.hard_failure_threshold: Single geographic region constitutes > 70% of parent scenes
readiness_matrix.scientific_rationale: Prevents the model from memorizing specific bathymetric, coastal topography, or localized sea-surface temperature patterns.

readiness_matrix.minimum_target: >= 3 calendar years represented, distributed across >= 8 calendar months
readiness_matrix.preferred_target: >= 5 calendar years with balanced seasonal distribution
readiness_matrix.hard_failure_threshold: Single 3-month seasonal cluster accounts for > 75% of scenes
readiness_matrix.scientific_rationale: Mitigates seasonal bias in atmospheric stability, storm tracks, and seasonal biogenic bloom cycles.

readiness_matrix.minimum_target: Both Ascending and Descending passes >= 30% each; all 3 IW sub-swaths (IW1, IW2, IW3) represented
readiness_matrix.preferred_target: Multi-polarization (VV + VH) available for >= 50% of scenes
readiness_matrix.hard_failure_threshold: Single orbit pass accounts for > 85% of scenes
readiness_matrix.scientific_rationale: Backscatter intensity and feature visibility vary significantly with look direction relative to prevailing wind and wave vectors.

readiness_matrix.minimum_target: >= 10 independent parent scenes containing HM; >= 5,000 valid HM pixels
readiness_matrix.hard_failure_threshold: < 5 parent scenes or < 1,000 valid HM pixels
readiness_matrix.scientific_rationale: In EXP-07, HM comprised only 985 pixels (0.021% of TRAIN) across 2 scenes, making feature learning practically impossible.

readiness_matrix.minimum_target: >= 15 independent parent scenes featuring natural slicks (BS) and low-wind areas (LWA)
readiness_matrix.preferred_target: >= 30 independent parent scenes across varied wind regimes
readiness_matrix.scientific_rationale: Ensures that future oil-spill models have a statistically diverse foundation of false-alarm look-alikes.

readiness_matrix.minimum_target: Zero parent scene sharing between splits; minimum 50 km spatial buffer between repeat passes in different splits
readiness_matrix.preferred_target: Spatially and temporally disjoint regional clusters
readiness_matrix.hard_failure_threshold: Any parent scene or along-track slice shared across TRAIN, DEV, or HOLDOUT
readiness_matrix.scientific_rationale: Absolute mathematical requirement to prevent data leakage and pseudo-replication.

sufficiency_rule: OPS-02 acquisition may NOT transition to training if any single dimension fails its hard failure threshold. The minimum targets represent gating boundaries, not optimal sample counts.
